Concept sheet of THREE separate stylized 3D game environment assets for a cozy fantasy village, in the hand-painted, soft, warm painterly style and daylight palette of the reference image (stylized like a modern anime-inspired 3D RPG, clean shapes, slightly chunky proportions). Arrange them side by side in one row with wide empty space between them, each object complete and fully visible, never overlapping, never cropped.
1) a two-storey half-timbered house: cream plaster walls, dark brown timber frame, jettied upper floor, steep warm red-brown tiled roof, stone chimney, low grey stone foundation, wooden door, small shuttered windows.
2) a small one-storey cottage: half-timbered, tall steep roof with brown tiles, a side lean-to woodshed, round stone chimney, flower box under a window.
3) a narrow tall townhouse: half-timbered upper floors over a stone ground floor, blue-grey slate roof, dormer window, hanging wooden shop sign without any letters.
Each house seen from a three-quarter front view, camera slightly above (about 30 degrees), same scale. Plain flat light grey background, no ground, no floor, no cast shadows, no scenery. Even soft lighting with almost no shading, flat hand-painted colors and soft painted textures, no black ink outlines, no text, no labels.
